## Summary

I resolved ticket T-2005 by identifying that the ledger-export cronjob failures are caused by the `activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600` timeout being exceeded. The pod logs revealed the job is processing 9.3 million rows and takes approximately 70 minutes to complete, exceeding the 1-hour deadline. The fix is to increase the `activeDeadlineSeconds` value in the CronJob spec to at least 1.5-2 hours to allow the export to complete successfully.
